answer: 그리고 향후 공통하네스(CI) Workflow에 이러한 메타데이터도 반드시 추가하도록 해야돼.
meaning: Future canonical common CI workflows and affected consumers must require actual source-author/native identity and logical Work/Task/source binding metadata. Native thread/session differs from nullable native Task/Run; authoritative source head/tree and exact metadata Git blob/hash are read back after commit/publication without self-reference. GHA cannot invent original authorship; no credentials/raw sessions/private data are published. Existing independent review gates remain. This WSL exception does not silently extend to future defaults.
